name: PostgreSQL
notes: Database ports are not published. Connect from services in the same Compose resource, or configure networking explicitly. Initial credentials apply only to an empty volume.
compose:
services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:18-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:?Set database name}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:?Set database user}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?Set database password}
    volumes:
      - data:/var/lib/postgresql
    healthcheck:
      test: [CMD-SHELL, 'pg_isready -U "$${POSTGRES_USER}" -d "$${POSTGRES_DB}"']
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
volumes:
  data:

name: MariaDB
notes: Database ports are not published. Connect from services in the same Compose resource, or configure networking explicitly. Initial credentials apply only to an empty volume.
compose:
services:
  mariadb:
    image: mariadb:11.8
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MARIADB_DATABASE: ${MARIADB_DATABASE:?Set database name}
      MARIADB_USER: ${MARIADB_USER:?Set database user}
      MARIADB_PASSWORD: ${MARIADB_PASSWORD:?Set database password}
      MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD:?Set root password}
    volumes:
      - data:/var/lib/mysql
    healthcheck:
      test: [CMD, healthcheck.sh, --connect, --innodb_initialized]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
volumes:
  data:

name: Beszel
description: Lightweight server metrics, history and alerts.
notes: Installs the hub only. Create your administrator account on first visit, then enroll agents from Beszel. This template does not grant Docker socket or host access.
compose:
services:
  beszel:
    image: henrygd/beszel:0.21.2
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      APP_URL: ${APP_URL:?Set the public URL}
    volumes:
      - data:/beszel_data
    healthcheck:
      test: [CMD, /beszel, health, --url, 'http://localhost:8090']
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
volumes:
  data:

name: Uptime Kuma
description: Uptime checks, notifications and status pages.
notes: Create the administrator account on first visit. Use local storage for the data volume; network filesystems may not support the locking required by SQLite.
compose:
services:
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:2
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - data:/app/data
volumes:
  data:

name: Umami
description: Website analytics with a bundled PostgreSQL database.
notes: After deploying, sign in with the upstream initial account admin / umami and replace its password immediately. The generated database password and signing keys are separate from that login.
compose:
services:
  umami:
    image: ghcr.io/umami-software/umami:3.5.0
    init: true
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://umami:${DATABASE_PASSWORD:?Set database password}@db:5432/umami
      APP_SECRET: ${APP_SECRET:?Set application secret}
      TWO_FACTOR_ENCRYPTION_KEY: ${TWO_FACTOR_ENCRYPTION_KEY:?Set encryption key}
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: [CMD-SHELL, 'curl --fail http://localhost:3000/api/heartbeat']
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
  db:
    image: postgres:18-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: umami
      POSTGRES_USER: umami
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DATABASE_PASSWORD:?Set database password}
    volumes:
      - data:/var/lib/postgresql
    healthcheck:
      test: [CMD, pg_isready, -U, umami, -d, umami]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
volumes:
  data:
